description: Keeping about 270 customer websites and 410 mailboxes online: account-level settings, DNS, TLS certificates, and escalation to the upstream provider when a server fails
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Every customer's public website and email stop together; 12 online stores lose sales; the 99.9% uptime guarantee allows about 43 minutes a month before service credits; credits of one month's fee for about 150 customers would exceed $5,000; RPO set by the upstream provider's nightly backups
manual_workaround: Post status on the customer portal and by text; temporary email forwarding to customers' personal addresses; restore affected accounts from the upstream backup; move a critical store to a second upstream server if the provider allows
dependent_people_or_facilities: Owner (single point of failure for escalation and DNS changes)

description: Support tickets, phone and text support, malware cleanup, and security incident response for customers
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Customers cannot reach anyone during an outage or compromise; the 10-day Florida third-party agent notice (Fla. Stat. 501.171(6)(a)) runs from determination; ticket history lives in the portal
manual_workaround: Phone and text from the owner's mobile phone; a printed customer contact list (planned, POL-01 10.1); email from a backup address if the business email is unavailable
dependent_people_or_facilities: Owner (single point of failure; only support person)

business_process: Account provisioning, billing, and domain renewals
description: New hosting accounts, plan changes, suspensions for non-payment, invoices, card payments, and domain renewals
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Billing can wait a few days; domain renewals are automatic but a failed renewal charge must be fixed before the domain expires; provisioning delays lose new sales only
manual_workaround: Provision accounts directly in the reseller console (SYS-02) and renew domains directly in the registrar account (SYS-03); invoice manually from the accounting SaaS
dependent_third_parties: Customer portal vendor; registrar; payment processor

description: Weekly bulk updates, daily scans, premium backups, and one-click admin access for 120 care-plan sites through the dashboard and security service
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Updates and scans can pause for a few days without harm; a compromised dashboard is more dangerous than an unavailable one, so pausing it is acceptable (P08); RPO 24 hours for premium backups
manual_workaround: Pause bulk updates; patch urgent vulnerabilities site by site through each site's admin area; rely on upstream backups
dependent_third_parties: Dashboard vendor; security service vendor; upstream hosting provider
dependent_people_or_facilities: Owner; freelance developer (about 8 hours a week)

description: Business email, documents, accounting, taxes, and vendor contracts
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Administrative deadlines are measured in days; file storage keeps version history
manual_workaround: Use the vendors' web portals from the phone; paper copies of key contracts at home
dependent_third_parties: Productivity suite vendor; accounting SaaS; outside accountant
